rejected.reason: novelty-critic: Required benchmark novelty coverage is absent. artifacts/novelty.json compares 2,146 catalog records but contains no LIBERO, RoboCasa, SimplerEnv, BEHAVIOR, DataCenterBench, or RoboDojo comparison, so selector/registry coverage and meaningful objective/ability/success-condition distinctions remain unverified.; Potentially relevant original definitions that still require explicit comparison include LIBERO “turn_on_the_stove”; RoboCasa KitchenStove tasks; SimplerEnv OpenDrawerInSceneEnv; BEHAVIOR “locking_every_door”; DataCenterBench “Turn a knob” and “Turn a key” (https://robocurve.org/datacenterbench/); and RoboDojo “fasten_screws” (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/robodojo-benchmark/RoboDojo/f57e1633ffed59761bc8e568cfe7530c4b33381c/task/RoboDojo/tasks/fasten_screws.py). None alone establishes overlap, but required distinctions were not recorded.; The selected asset plan repeats known source-reading errors: it calls 11.2 mm the rod diameter and 14.5 mm the adjustment diameter. The primary table and operator notes establish D=4.0 mm rod diameter, G=11.2 mm knob diameter, H=14.5 mm axial length, and A=100.6 mm overall envelope—not body length. The selection must be corrected before contract freezing.; The selected objective correctly keeps the setscrew captive and requires physical hex-key manipulation, collar adjustment, relocking, and dynamic impact testing. However, its wording should explicitly require withdrawing and re-engaging the bit because the lock screw moves with the numbered collar; full screw extraction/reinstallation must not be introduced.; The 17 uncertain catalog records are nonblocking only if each is closed, unmerged, other-team, non-board-required history. The catalog confirms closed status and own_team=false for sampled pr-1110, but artifacts/novelty.json does not preserve auditable evidence for unmerged and non-board-required scope across all 17 exemptions. Retain uncertainty and verify every exemption explicitly.; The previous failure (“all proposed candidates duplicate/uncertain”) is not resolved because required six-suite comparisons are missing. Catalog count completeness alone cannot establish novelty.
